note: AS-BUILT (implement ②). The binding between a tmux session and a work item is the session NAME (launch.sessionName mints it once; launch.SessionAction is the only parser), so every reader - the card dot, the agent chip, the building/stalled cues, the per-source concurrency cap, the one-owner lock's liveness cross-check and the sweeper - re-derives from that one string. 0.32.0 makes the string editable from the cockpit: P mints a correctly-named /gogo:plan session for a card (confirm -> launch -> attach; a live one is joined), K (promoted to the board) kills a chosen session behind the existing confirm/picker, and R renames a live session onto the item it is really driving via the tui renamer seam -> launch.RenameSessionUnique (action derived from the target's status by bindAction, so the cap keeps counting builds). New pure pieces: launch.SessionMeta/ListSessionMeta/parseSessionMeta, launch.SessionNameFor/RenameSessionArgs/RenameSession(Unique), tui/session_ops.go (bindAction, boundFeature, unboundSessions, pathWithinRoot, plan/kill/adopt flows), the pickerOrigin cancel-origin fix, and the unbound count on the idle status line. No class diagram: the change adds one launch seam plus pure TUI helpers over existing types, so a structure view would carry no signal the flow does not already carry. before/ holds the plan-time as-is baseline.
